Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Startup Exemption: Startups registered with DPIIT, holding an Udyam certificate, and registered as MSEs wi th CSPO or NSIC are exempt from prior experience and minimum turnover requirements. However, their an nual production capacity must be at least twice the bid quantity. Note: Resellers or traders of products do not qualify for startup benefits. MSE Manufacturers/Service Providers: Micro & Small Enterprises participating directly for items/services th ey manufacture or provide, having Udyam registration alongside CSPO or NSIC registration. Quality Standard: Products supplied must be ISI-certified and in good condition. Delivery & Late Penalty: Items must be delivered within the stipulated schedule. Delayed deliveries incur a penalty deduction of 0.5% per week. Cancellation Rights: If the bid is canceled by the buyer, sellers cannot raise any objections. Product Rejection: If goods are rejected for any reason, the seller is fully responsible for taking them back a t their own cost. .
